ḍenti: [Ḍi+a+anti] (kri) CL=8 (1) They fly away. (2) They set a (snare). (3) They were pas judgement (or) they are arranged. Ḍeti-Look.
ḍessāmi: [Ḍi+ssāmi] (kri) CL=8 will fly away. Ḍeti - (1) - See.
ḍeti:
[Ḍi+a+ti] (kri) CL=8 Ḍi vihāyasagatiyaṃ gamanamatte ca. Ḍeti, ḍayati, ḍemāno. Ḍi khipanuḍḍanesu. Ḍeti, uḍḍeti. Nīti,dhā.57.] (1) It flies. It flew away. It flies up. (2) It sets up a trap. 
who pass judgement (or) who  arranged.(3) who throw it down. (4)   It is being.(5) it makes. to be cause.

ḍetvā: [Ḍi+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=8 to go, to fly away.
